### 1. Technical Environment

* **code_version:** a86d9f4a72a6a335b25197c070c5c169bbe9b831

### 2. Incident Overview

* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior

#### Expected Behavior

`ticket list-epics` should display the user-friendly alias (e.g., `musty-hood-axe`) in place of the full UUID when the epic has a registered alias. The alias is the human-readable identifier surfaced by `ticket show` and other commands.

#### Actual Behavior

`ticket list-epics` outputs the full UUID (e.g., `0740-2df7-ee90-4ca4`) for every epic regardless of whether a user-friendly alias is available, making the output harder to scan and inconsistent with other commands that prefer the alias.
data.title: ticket list-epics: displaying epic IDs -> full UUID shown instead of user-friendly alias when alias is available
